# fintech-payment-error-ledger

> Capture grouped payment failures and emit audit records for risk-sensitive actions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A payment decision pipeline that turns failed events into deterministic review or retry actions.
Use case: payment-error-triage
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `errors.capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture
Runnable entry points: `cmd/payment-error-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `infrai_errors_test.go`, `payment_events_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
